policy: Research inventory only. A paper's Creative Commons license is not the same as the underlying dataset license; a user-published repository label is not sufficient proof of third-party image rights. Cannot self-authorize by editing this file.

candidates.reported_images: 634 panoramic FDI-enumeration annotations plus distinct other challenge splits
candidates.evidence: Official publisher README: data licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 while the rest of code MIT; Hugging Face dataset metadata also cc-by-nc-sa-4.0. Third-party papers reporting CC BY-SA must not override rights-holder noncommercial text.

Zenodo uploader Niha Adnan, 250 panoramic JSON annotations, Rights/License field blank; article in Data in Brief CC BY-NC and 250 samples aggregated from three original datasets. Article license does not independently establish commercial rights for dataset images.

candidates.reported_images: about 2066 publicly cited; original paper describes a larger 5000 mixed-origin collection
candidates.evidence: Original clinical ethics approval #2024011704 is research-specific and not a commercial redistribution permission; data aggregate hospital and externally obtained radiographs, with unclear image-level commercial/cloud rights; paper open-access license does not prove Kaggle dataset license.

Public page shows 1577 source images and all 32 labels but expressly no description. Dataset version 1 has 3503 AUGMENTED examples, not independently acquired radiographs; requires provenance, patient-level split and augmentation leakage audit.
Roboflow instance segmentation lists 623 images and 32 FDI labels with CC BY 4.0 card, but project description unprovided, unknown clinic/image rights and deduplication against previous datasets.

candidates.reported_images: 107 original instance-segmented plus 60 anatomical-type images and 54 later additions
candidates.evidence: University identifiable and source clinics reported, but 60 labels refer to eight anatomical tooth types, not to the specific 32 permanent FDI identifiers. Consent/clinical image copyright/cloud processing still unverified.
NLM public catalog shows 3000 OPGs with segmentation and COCO annotations, but class schema not verified as 32 FDI identifiers; original patient-image sublicensing and cloud rights not reviewed.
